Here's a draft for your LinkedIn post:

---

I'm thrilled to announce that I've been selected as a member of the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🎉

After working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I'm honored to now have the opportunity to help shape its future development. Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks continues to be a critical standard for improving clinical workflows and supporting healthcare providers with real-time, contextually relevant guidance.

If you're already using CDS Hooks in your organization, please take a moment to add your implementation to our community registry: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

Not using CDS Hooks yet? I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you implement this powerful standard and enhance your clinical decision support capabilities. Let's connect and discuss how CDS Hooks can transform your healthcare technology ecosystem.

#HealthIT #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthcareTechnology #StandardsDevelopment

---

Would you like me to modify anything in the post?
